planned_change: Serialize directly to UTF8 bytes and deserialize those bytes, preserving the existing JsonElement fast path. Do not copy serializer internals or add a cache.
tuning_after_comparison_1: The byte-array prototype reduced CPU but increased large-payload allocations about40 percent. Reuse the existing shared PooledMemoryStream with BCL stream serialization and span deserialization; preserve all original compatibility/measurement criteria and retain the rejected prototype separately.
producer: Actual public JsonPatchDocument.Replace and Copy operations, including a real serialized/deserialized patch as the JsonElement control.
compatibility: Every new numeric/options/failure and deep-copy/reference-handling row passes individually on original and changed source.
Preserve actual public patch outcomes, failed-conversion non-mutation, custom serializer options and deep-copy reference independence.
Existing custom-converter and full owning tests pass.
No exported API change, persistent cache, package or configuration changes.

measurement.owner: Actual public JsonPatchDocument.ApplyTo, not a copied serializer/helper.
measurement.cases: Scalar conversion and assignable control; object projection, object copy, array copy and actual deserialized JsonElement control at sizes1,16,256,4096.
measurement.early_stop: A clear large win can stop early; reject or tune material allocation regressions rather than publish only a CPU headline.
measurement.scope: Public patch CPU and managed allocations, not HTTP throughput. Programmatic typed values and copies reach the changed path; deserialized JsonElement values retain their original path.
